title: Learning in Symbiosis: Heterogeneous Federated Learning with ANNs and SNNs
abstract: arXiv:2611.27686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), widely regarded as the third generation of neural networks, represent a promising neuromorphic computing paradigm with the potential to reduce the energy footprint of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Their en-ergy efficiency makes SNNs particularly attractive for resource-constrained Edge AI devices, motivating growing research interest in Federated Learning (FL) with SNNs. Despite these advantages, integrating SNNs into existing FL systems remains challenging, as replacing all conventional Artificial Neural Network (ANN) devices with SNN-based alternatives is impractical. Instead, we envision a gradual transition toward neuromorphic Edge AI, where ANN and SNN devices coexist and collaboratively participate in FL. To facilitate this transition, we propose Hybrid Neuromorphic Federated Learning (HNFL), a framework that enables joint training of heterogeneous ANN and SNN devices within an FL environment. Throug

translated_title: 共生学习：基于人工神经网络与脉冲神经网络的异构联邦学习
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）被广泛认为是第三代神经网络，代表了一种有前景的神经形态计算范式，有潜力降低人工智能（AI）的能源足迹。其能效优势使SNN对资源受限的边缘AI设备特别具有吸引力，这也推动了对SNN与联邦学习（FL）相结合的研究兴趣日益增长。尽管具有这些优势，将SNN集成到现有联邦学习系统中仍然具有挑战性，因为用基于SNN的替代设备替换所有传统人工神经网络（ANN）设备是不切实际的。相反，我们设想了一种向神经形态边缘AI的渐进式过渡，其中ANN和SNN设备共存并协作参与联邦学习。为促进这一过渡，我们提出了混合神经形态联邦学习（HNFL），这是一个能够在联邦学习环境中对异构ANN和SNN设备进行联合训练的框架。
tldr: 本文提出混合神经形态联邦学习框架，使异构的人工神经网络与脉冲神经网络设备能够在联邦学习环境中协同联合训练，从而推动向节能神经形态边缘AI的渐进式过渡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Hybrid Neuromorphic Federated Learning (HNFL), a framework that enables joint training of heterogeneous ANN and SNN devices in a federated learning environment, facilitating a gradual transition toward energy-efficient neuromorphic Edge AI.
